mission: SNKRDUNK collector fix for the 2026-10-26 page change (owner 'go', perfectionist). (1) Photo: the retained gallery resolves Flight module names given by reference ($<key> string records). (2) Prices: a product snapshot waits for that product's own size-chips response (the page's price request, /v2/products/<id>/size-chips, at most 15 s), lets the page render it, and is accepted only when a chip shows a real price. (3) Safety: a page with no rendered price is never recorded as 'nothing listed'; it is a transient failure with the reason in last_failure, and its price response body is kept as evidence. A 403/429 or challenge on that request is a source denial. Released to snkrdunk-collector only, by staging-automerge.

impacts.reason: Collector behaviour: product captures wait (bounded) for the page's own price response before the snapshot; no new request is made (the response body is read from the browser). The product navigation deadline goes from 50 s to 56 s. When no chip shows a price, the size-chips body is stored as a second raw snapshot. The infrastructure effect is the mission-scoped release of snkrdunk-collector.
Tests from the live page shapes; each new case failed on the previous code.

resources: raw_snapshots: one extra small row per capture whose page shows no price
routes: SNKRDUNK product pages, unchanged set; the page's own size-chips request is already made by the page and metered
dependencies: then a fleet-pin PR (snkr_component to the merge SHA)
then snkr-parser-requeue window update, canary, rest (owner-approved)
impact.deployment_impact: snkrdunk-collector re-uploaded on the merge commit with automatic rollback. SNKRDUNK captures then record real prices; a page without rendered prices retries instead of reading as no listing.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures the live snkrdunk-collector deployment before upload and restores it on failure; afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: SNKRDUNK captures still refused, prices mis-parsed, or every capture prices_not_loaded after release.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify; product_result logs show condition_prices loaded on the next SNKR turns; then the requeue canary captures a price.
